sloka: अर्थेन हि वियुक्तस्य पुरुषस्याल्पतेजसः।व्युच्छिद्यन्ते क्रियाः सर्वा ग्रीष्मे कुसरितो यथा ।। ६.८३.३३ ।।
transliteration: arthena hi viyuktasya puruṣasyālpatejasaḥ।vyucchidyante kriyāḥ sarvā grīṣme kusarito yathā ।। 6.83.33 ।।

translations.english: "Just like streams dry up in summer, if one who is of meagre intelligence and forsakes wealth, all his actions will be interrupted."
